title: Node event
description: A new version of node `n`. The server resolves `n`, assigns `ver` and takes the board from the path; a sent item may name `base`, the version it was based on. Its `kind` decides whether it asks the person for an answer.

node.description: The content of this version of the node.

node.title: Flat fee or per seat?
node.body: Which model fits a team of ten?

base.description: The `ver` you read; if the card has moved on, the item fails with `conflict`.

insert.description: Put this card (new or existing) between two linked cards of one `flow` or `lanes` container, in one write: `after`→`before` becomes `after`→card→`before`, keeping the label. Its `region` must be that container.
insert.$comment: Sent only: the ledger gets the node, unlink and link lines (PLAN Decision 5, point 424).

by.description: Who wrote the line; always `agent` for this event.

board.description: The board the line belongs to; the server takes it from the path.

ver.description: The node version this line wrote.

noItem.description: A node names no `item`: its kind decides whether it asks for an answer.
noItem.$comment: Kept apart from `body`, which names `item`, so a line or item naming it gets these words alone. Was: api.md 118

item.description: `item` is gone: the kind decides. A `question`, `decision` or `action` card asks the person; any other kind takes a note or Later.

rules.description: A stored line names no `item`; an app card names its app and no other card names one.
rules.$comment: Kept apart from `core` so a failed rule never hides which fields are known (see common.schema.json `stampAgent`). Was: api.md 118, 150

allOf.$comment: Always applies; through `if`/`then` so the generators read the node's fields from `core`, not from this piece.

appRule.description: Kind `app` needs `app` and takes no `size`; no other kind names an app.
appRule.$comment: Kept apart from `body` so a failed rule never hides which fields are known. Was: api.md 150, D-047 ruling 3

size.description: An app card is as big as its panel; set app.w and app.h instead.

timeline.description: An app card is a window with no header for a date; put the date on another card.

app.description: Only an app card names an app; draw kind `app`.

fields.description: Every field of a node but `timeline`, whose stored and sent forms differ (`body`, `sentBody`).
fields.$comment: Open here: `body` and `sentBody` close it with their own `timeline`. Was: api.md 190, D-105

region.description: The container (region) the node sits in.

kind.description: `question`, `decision` and `action` ask the person for ✓ or ✗; `finding`, `risk`, `topic` and `note` don't; `app` shows an app you built in a panel (name it in `app`). The person can note or save any node.

item.description: Gone: the node's kind decides whether it asks for an answer. A line or item naming it is refused (`noItem`).

lane.description: The lane the node sits in, for a container in `lanes` mode.

emphasis.description: True draws the card emphasised; never over the person's size.

size.description: Your suggested size; the person's wins. Not on an app card.

app.description: App cards only, and required there: which app, and the panel's size in px.

icon.description: An icon drawn on the node: a built-in name, or one from the project's icon library (`x-` then what it shows). Call list_icons first; reuse before you add one with add_icon.

tone.description: The node's tone: a palette name, or a hue from 0 to 359 (the OKLCH hue angle). Use it to set apart the parts of a flow or show which nodes belong together; leave it out when the kind already says it.

body.description: A node as the ledger holds it and every read gives it: its `timeline`, when it has one, in its stored form.

timeline.description: The node's date, which puts it on its container's timeline: `2026`, `2026-10`, `2026-10-13` or `2026-10-13T14:30`.

sentBody.description: A node as an agent sends it: `body`, with `timeline` taken in the forms the board normalises.

timeline.description: A date: nodes with one share their container's timeline, a line in date order. `2026`, `2026-10`, `2026-10-13` or `2026-10-13T14:30`: the precision is what you write, the time as written (no zone). The board drops a zone or seconds and reads a space as `T`; a quarter, a week or words are refused. Not on an app card. A rewrite without it takes the node off the line.
timeline.$comment: write-board.ts normalises it (normaliseTimeline) before this schema is checked. Was: api.md 190, D-105

node.description: The content of this version of the node.
